answer_1.quote: Summarization evaluation metrics that measure the quality of generated summaries are very important for the development of summarization systems.

answer_2.quote: Our proposed SDC and SDC* achieve better performance than the SOTA summarization evaluation metric on CNN/Daily Mail and TAC 2010 datasets.

answer_3.quote: In our experiments 3 , we follow to use GPT-2 small language model to compute the semantic distribution of text.

answer_4.quote: Each summary was scored by 3 experts under four aspects: coherence, consistency, fluency, and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: Experts scored summaries based on coherence, consistency, fluency, relevance for CNNDM and overall score incorporating coverage and linguistic quality for TAC.
